name: printify-mcp
description: Printify (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, create_order, get_order. Every tool

platform_mcp_printify_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PRINTIFY_TOKEN
platform_mcp_printify_token.description: Printify personal access token (My profile > Connections) sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

platform_mcp_printify_shop_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PRINTIFY_SHOP_ID
platform_mcp_printify_shop_id.description: Printify shop id (from GET /v1/shops.json); required by get_order and create_order, which are per shop.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v1/shops.json lists the merchant's shops [{id, title, sales_channel}]; take the shop id from here for the shop_id setting.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Blank-product catalogue (blueprints [{id, title, brand, model, images[]}]); unpaginated, the full list is returned and `query`/`category` are not accepted by the endpoint. Catalog calls are limited to 100/minute.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One blueprint; variants and prices are per print provider (GET /v1/catalog/blueprints/{id}/print_providers/{ppid}/variants.json, not mapped).

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: POST /v1/shops/{shop_id}/orders.json creates the order in the shop; it is NOT submitted for production (a separate documented call), so nothing is charged by this tool. `items` are Printify line_items [{product_id, variant_id, quantity}], `shipping_address` is address_to {first_name, last_name, email, phone, country, region, address1, address2, city, zip}, `shipping_option` is the numeric shipping_method id from the shipping estimate. Needs the shop_id setting.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /v1/shops/{shop_id}/orders/{order_id}.json: {id, status, total_price, total_shipping, created_at, shipments[{carrier, number, url, delivered_at}]}; amounts are integers in cents. Needs the shop_id setting.
